result.title: Cross-Version Compatibility of TESSERA Embeddings Through Lightweight Translation
result.summary: Downstream models often outlive the embedding release on which they were trained. We test whether lightweight converters let a classifier trained on one Tessera release use embeddings from another. We fit converters between v1, v1.1, and v2 on 6,280 co-located triplets from 25 sites in 2024, with disjoint training, validation, and test sites. On a four-class land-cover test, a classifier trained on true v2 reaches 0.937 accuracy and 0.844 macro-F1. The same classifier scores 0.061 and 0.050 on raw v1.1, but 0.917 and 0.795 on converted v1.1. Direct v1-to-v2 translation has lower error than composition through v1.1. Geographic transfer is less reliable. On a separate cohort of 20 sites, a converter trained on the original sites reaches 0.597 accuracy despite 0.902 cosine similarity to v2, whereas a converter trained within the new cohort reaches 0.784. Tests with 2021 WorldCover labels and at 24 sampled sites without valid native v2 values extend the evaluation. Conversion recovers much of the frozen classifier's performance on the tested sites, but the new-site result shows that embedding similarity cannot stand in for downstream evaluation.

AI.brief_summary: 在 TESSERA 遥感嵌入的 v1、v1.1、v2 之间拟合轻量转换器，检验冻结分类器能否跨版本复用，并在独立站点队列上评估地理迁移的可靠性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「嵌入余弦相似度高并不代表下游可用」的结论，可能为 LVR 中 latent 相似度指标与实际答案利用之间的脱节提供类比与核查线索；跨版本轻量转换也可供思考跨层或跨版本的 latent 状态对齐。
